title: Wellington Cable Car Review
meta_desc: Discover the Wellington Cable Car experience with kids. Get insider tips, prices, and honest reviews to plan your family trip to Wellington, NZ.
intro: The Wellington Cable Car is a must-do experience for families visiting Wellington. This iconic attraction has been running since 1902 and offers stunning views of the city. We took our kids on the cable car and here's our honest review.

sections.heading: What to Expect
sections.body:
The Wellington Cable Car is a 4-minute ride that takes you from Lambton Quay to the Botanic Garden at the top of the city. The panoramic views of the harbour are breathtaking, and kids will love looking out the window as the city unfolds below.

The cable car is stroller-friendly, and babies as young as 0+ can ride, making it an excellent activity for families with little ones. The 30-minute ride is followed by a 45-minute walk back down through the beautiful Botanic Garden, which is free and a great way to stretch your legs.
list: Free walk back through the Botanic Garden

sections.heading: Value for Money
sections.body: The Wellington Cable Car costs $12 per adult and $6 per child, which we think is reasonable for the experience you get. However, if you're traveling with a large family, it may add up quickly. Consider purchasing a family pass or looking for discounts online to save money.

sections.heading: Insider Tips and Best Time to Visit
sections.body: To avoid the crowds, visit the Wellington Cable Car early in the morning or later in the afternoon. You can book your tickets online in advance, which we recommend doing during peak season. If you're looking for a unique experience, consider visiting at night when the city is all lit up.
list: Visit early in the morning or late in the afternoon to avoid crowds
Book tickets online in advance for peak season
Visit at night for a unique experience

sections.heading: Family Suitability and Downsides
sections.body: We give the Wellington Cable Car a family suitability rating of 9/10. The only downside is that the cable car can be a bit crowded, especially during peak season. Additionally, the walk back down through the garden can be steep in some areas, so be sure to bring a stroller that can handle rough terrain.
list: Can be crowded during peak season
Walk back down through the garden can be steep in some areas
